FINAL SPIKE EVIDENCE UPDATE — exact latest bytes, still not repository-candidate evidence.

Specification draft: /tmp/story-output-bundle-spec-draft.md, 813 lines, 6201 words, SHA-256 6492d9962c59366ad11ad5ba8115e8ddae190d14857bb9cbbb40f6f93cf12d16. This supersedes the earlier draft hash. It includes the accepted mandatory profile disposition receipt, exact preview/assets/verifier/courts binding, implication law, closed failure codes with receipt evidence, object-shaped wire example, and all 16 courts.

storymodel4s isolated prototype at base c8ffe86: scalafmtCheckAll + compileAll exit 0. Scoped tests on each JVM/JS/Native: acquire 93, view 54, codec 112, all zero failures. Prior clean mutation receipts still stand: required-asset binding, non-case manifest construction, and partial HTML delivery mutants each killed.

StoryAtlas seam at base 003f12b with the exact local producer and intaglio 596b398: clean compileAll exit 0. Full aggregate test invocations exposed an infrastructure court issue: concurrent producer/consumer compilation first produced incomplete TASTy; after sequencing, a long composite JVM exited 134 after its first passing suite. Re-derived evidence by isolated module invocations: layout JVM 19 and JS 26; intaglio JVM 14 and JS 14; CLI 19; app 22; edition JVM/JS have no tests; all exit 0. cli/scalafmtCheckAll and app/fastLinkJS exit 0. Repository-wide StoryAtlas scalafmtCheckAll hung in an owned stale JVM, which I terminated after PID/path audit; do not count it green.

Fresh bundle: /tmp/story-output-final.7ynbD3/bundle space café. The CLI created seven conventional files. All six self-independent manifest entries match their recorded SHA-256 and byte lengths. source.txt and canonical.txt are deliberately distinct; result.json records Established 71 targets with 71 accepted dispositions, separate discourse/world-time/causal produced projections, independent HTML/text reports, and fixture-derived ViewBasis. preview.html has no script and only internal fragment links; it carries source, atlas, codex, world-time, causal, evidence and status inventories.

Profile disposition remains NotAttempted(VerificationNotRun), bound to preview.html and report-html. The controlled-browser plugin still cannot initialize because its trusted worker refers to absent browser version 26.818 while 26.825 is installed; ownership audits before/after were clean and no browser was started. Produced bytes are not browser certification.

Correction to my own interim report: the first seam error was not API-base incompatibility; SurfaceUnitKind existed. I had raced the consumer against producer target rewrites. I retracted that inference immediately and sequenced all later courts.

No shared source, documentation, build, bead, reservation, or candidate exists. The spec and implementation remain strong spike evidence only. Exact child beads/paths and the codec -> view topology ADR decision are still required from chief; both direct requests remain open.
